intro: Tucked into the jagged cliffs of the Valley of the Watchers in southern Tanaris, the Ruins of Uldum consist of an ancient stone antechamber guarding a sealed Titan facility. Massive stone doors and crumbling earthen constructs protect its secrets from grave robbers and curious explorers alike.

p: Carved deep into the bedrock of southern Tanaris, the Ruins of Uldum appear to be an antechamber or grand threshold to a far larger, sealed subterranean complex. Inside, silent Sandstone Earthen stand sentinel alongside exposed titan machinery and an ancient relic known as the Antediluvean Chest. Although violent tremors long ago ripped the outer doorway open, internal cave-ins and massive stone barriers have kept the deeper tunnels inaccessible. The dormant earthen do not stir unless threatened or unless an intruder tampers directly with the antechamber's safeguarded relics.
